name: Feeds Enhanced - Token Support
description: Provides universal token expansion for all Feeds text fields and configurations.
project_description: Feeds Enhanced - Token Support is a submodule of Feeds Enhanced that provides universal token expansion for all Feed and Feed type text fields and configurations. Any string containing [token] syntax is expanded during every feed import, with no configuration required, via an event subscriber that listens to Feeds' INIT_IMPORT event at high priority. Expansion covers feed entity fields (source, label, custom fields), and fetcher, parser and processor plugin configurations. Token context includes feed, feed-type, current-user, date and site. A token browser is added to Feed and Feed Type forms for discovery. Session-based caching prevents redundant expansion within a single import. Addresses long-standing Feeds feature requests #3131079 and #3282260, and enables turn-key Pantheon Secure Integration pipelines when combined with the Pantheon SI Tokens module. Requires the Token module.
